definitions.explanation: To build again something that has fallen down or been destroyed.

definitions.gloss: to restore, to revive, to turn around
definitions.explanation: To restore something (business, finances, health, etc.) to a good state after it has declined.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{立|た}て{直|なお}した。
examples.english: I rebuilt the house that was destroyed by the earthquake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{立|た}て{直|なお}す⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to turn around the company's management.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{立|た}て{直|なお}すために⟦{休|やす}んでいる→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: I'm resting to recover my health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{立|た}て{直|なお}す⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a plan to rebuild the old shrine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧⟦{塀|へい}→塀：03613_hei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{立|た}て{直|なお}さなければならない。
examples.english: We have to rebuild the fence that was knocked down by the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{立|た}て{直|なお}すために⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}し→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I started looking for a new job to rebuild my life.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive).

CONJUGATION (godan): {立|た}て{直|なお}す → {立|た}て{直|なお}さない → {立|た}て{直|なお}した → {立|た}て{直|なお}して

COMPOUND VERB: ⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to stand up, to set up) + ⟦{直|なお}す→直す：00869_naosu⟧ (to fix, to redo)

COMMON OBJECTS:
- ⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{立|た}て{直|なお}す (turn around management)
- ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{立|た}て{直|なお}す (rebuild one's life)
- ⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{立|た}て{直|なお}す (recover one's health)
- ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{立|た}て{直|なお}す (revise/redo a plan)

The 〜⟦{直|なお}す→直す：00869_naosu⟧ pattern indicates doing something over again or redoing it properly.
